ops.title: Incident records: swarm post-mortem log, orchestration doc, convergence note
ops.description: Phase C of the stabilization plan (plan file codex-has-been-churning-humble-rain). After fleet convergence verifies: (1) `log_add` incident timeline in daemonkit cc-notes — the Jul 17-24 recursive codex swarm (150 top-level agents, ~1.8B tokens), the v0.19/v0.20 release churn, the settlement fix arc (task 4497f65 → v0.20.6 baseline), machine damage and repairs; (2) `doc_add` orchestration guidance ("when: orchestrating fleet-wide changes") — bounded workflows, single orchestrator, no recursive self-spawning, no unattended multi-day bypass sessions, batched releases, and the KeepAlive lesson: brew upgrade + symlink relink does NOT converge a running KeepAlive daemon (serve sat 14 minors stale) — daemonkit drain-on-upgrade exists for exactly this, confirm new synckit adopts it; (3) claude-pool investigation: the DeadlineKillsReapsAndUntracks test's kill/reap path orphaned a daemonkit-worker at 100% CPU for 3 days in the wild; (4) confirm existing records: 29a01afd (daemon flake), 34996a3b (spawn-gate P1), captain-hook f844470/ed97d09, cc-pool TerminateWithin heads-up, cc-steer.watch ticket; (5) update the fleet coordination note with final convergence status + lift-or-keep decision context for the daemonkit release freeze.
